overview: BIM Clash Resolution Workflow addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in construction and real estate operations. The first proof of value uses BIM versions, trade clash reports and approved design revisions. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is open critical clashes before build, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: BIM versions, trade clash reports and approved design revisions; define open critical clashes before build and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Development Director / Property Operations Head.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
